note: Coverage inventory, not execution evidence. mapped means an existing suite targets this criterion; partial/manual/deferred retain explicit gaps. See QUALITY.md and per-change evidence.

requirements.criterion: Phone and monitor submenus share Settings surfaces, typography, selection, icons and spacing.
requirements.gap: Automated native style/geometry assertions exist; no approved pixel baselines for the full state matrix.

requirements.criterion: Phone remains portrait; full-height menus keep Close reachable with scrolling and IME.
requirements.gap: Large accessibility font scales and split-screen sizes are not exhaustively exercised.

requirements.criterion: All menu labels, punctuation and icon descriptions render without encoding corruption.
requirements.gap: Existing glyph checks supplement manual rendering review; not every installed app name is enumerated.

requirements.criterion: Android-diving-into-monitor icon is monochrome and survives masks and small sizes.
No-app desktop shows a centered Apps action; touch and phone pointer launch it.
requirements.gap: Build-22 Samsung full run passes native/Fit idle and restored idle after task movement/explicit exit, including real Carousell phone handoff. Current Android 11 regression, failure-injection breadth and human visual approval remain gaps; sampled remaining-app presence does not approve its full-frame crop margins.

requirements.criterion: Monitor search keyboard edits, filters, handles lifecycle and preserves focus without opening phone IME.
requirements.gap: Build-22 Samsung full keyboard suite passes 50ms contacts, settled measured layout and exact editor checks per key. Earlier failed attempts remain failures. End-to-end input latency, hardware-keyboard variants and full current Android 17 keyboard coverage remain unverified.

requirements.criterion: Side-edge Back, bottom launcher and top controls navigate once relative to desktop rotation.
Rejected edge gestures preserve app input; modal menus dismiss outside without click-through.
Gesture feedback and menu transitions settle without orphan overlays or duplicate actions.
requirements.gap: Build-21 Samsung monitor suite passes release-committed and canceled edge actions in all four rotations using real InputDispatcher events. Settled geometry/lifecycle checks exist; frame pacing, mandatory Android-owned edge gestures and human transition pixel review remain manual.

requirements.criterion: Phone pad supports tap, native pinch, scroll and three-finger Back with contact arbitration.
Monitor touch maps through rotation/Fit, preserves contact IDs and hides the pointer.
Wheel/swipe mode and speed apply per app, including Tachiyomi defaults, and selected values persist.
requirements.gap: Reader page counts and third-party app-version behavior require real-app checks.

requirements.criterion: Saved rotation/scroll profiles remain per app; one-time launch and reset obey defaults.
requirements.gap: Some preference persistence is asserted in-process; cold process/reboot permutations need further E2E.

requirements.criterion: Display modes and recommended virtual resolution/UI DPI are honest about unknown physical DPI.
requirements.gap: One physical monitor tested historically; ignored physical-mode requests and EDID variants need hardware cases.

requirements.criterion: Selected desktop resolution stays proportional; unconfirmed preview rolls back in 15 seconds.
requirements.gap: Native confirmed-settings restart paths after binding/Forget and manual default rotation passed. Physical cable/fault injection, alternative ROMs and full third-party continuity remain unverified.

requirements.criterion: Desktop/input continue when phone controller is backgrounded or destroyed.
requirements.gap: Build-22 Samsung full run and Android 17 idle suite pass four completed background/reopen cycles, same-controller focus, real phone Settings/Close input and fresh monitor input. Exact cause of the original intermittent focus assertion is not established; fixed-delay TO_BACK setup was racy. Other OEM removed-window recovery and current Android 11 helper regression remain unverified.

requirements.criterion: Stop releases the desktop; reopening or launching starts it and reports connection state. Activity-host startup is bounded, cleans up on missing attachment and rejects late hosts/stale deadlines. Rejected foreground-service setup clears state and supports retry without escaping the main callback. Launcher reopening reuses the bound controller and retries startup; pending-request resume recovers, while focus restoration after explicit Stop remains stopped.
requirements.gap: Build-31 Android 11 full ten-suite run 20261015T172555.772434Z and targeted lifecycle run 20261015T172445.285421Z pass actual launcher reopening of the same bound controller after controlled foreground-adapter rejection and missing-host five-second timeout. Busy/id/wake cleanup, late generation/token rejection, stale-timeout safety, explicit Stop focus retention and visible-controller launcher recovery pass. IdleAcceptance.run invokes these scenario assertions through reopenController; it does not call service retry for recovery. These are component fault injections, not actual OS background-policy denial. Final-build modern-device runtime, broader reconnect/error injection and abrupt process-death recovery remain gaps. See testresults/0.11.1/android11-release-validation/README.md.

requirements.criterion: Apps search, tap launch and held one-time orientation work on both surfaces.
requirements.gap: Build-22 Samsung passes different-UID private-child/Back, reparent/state/relaunch and remaining-task checks; actual Carousell external-to-phone handoff works. Current Android 17 child input is intermittent despite an earlier expanded pass. Remaining-app captures have crop/size margins; sampled task presence is not full-frame visual approval. Chrome/Firefox/ReVanced/Tachiyomi breadth and Android 11 current helper regression remain app/device-dependent gaps.

requirements.criterion: Diagnostics show accepted/rejected gestures and connection/key outcomes without typed content.
requirements.gap: Privacy checks and every failure-path message are not exhaustive.

requirements.criterion: Search, menu and input feedback have measured repeatable latency/frame baselines before performance claims.
requirements.gap: Build-23 Samsung catalog native-action-to-first-OnDraw samples (phone n10, monitor n12 across four rotations) and real worker scan durations are recorded. These exclude physical input delay and animation completion; the full 100-sample/10-warmup protocol, settled-menu budget and frame pacing remain unverified. See testresults/0.11.1/apps-loading/README.md.

requirements.criterion: UI changes are reviewed on rendered phone/monitor states against an approved design contract.
requirements.gap: Prior screenshots are historical evidence, not an approved reproducible golden set; manual signoff is required.

requirements.criterion: Formatting, lint, build, host/tool tests and requirement links are repeatable locally and in CI. Device runners require raw final Android result status independently of ADB exit.
Direct absolute phone gesture mode is optional and distinct from the current relative touchpad.
requirements.gap: Not shipped; no UI toggle or release claim until implemented and verified.

requirements.criterion: Concise setup/install/use README, separate changelog, Spec Kit-style spec, and versioned evidence retain valid links and raw-log hashes.

Tagged/manual GitHub release validates version/changelog, gates quality, signs and verifies APK/AAB with a persistent private key, attaches checksums and concise notes, and preserves published assets.

Every test change refreshes requirement-to-case coverage and source fingerprints; missing cases, unmapped entries and stale reports fail checks. Identical sources produce identical inventories across Windows/Linux path comparison and LF/CRLF checkout conventions.
requirements.gap: PR #3 Linux CI exposed platform-dependent mixed-case path ordering. The portability case passes under simulated case-insensitive comparison and requires explicit POSIX lexical order; 84 tooling cases and a clean Git export freshness check pass. Required Linux CI rerun is pending. This is tooling verification, not additional device coverage. See testresults/0.11.1/portable-coverage/README.md.

requirements.criterion: Two fresh independent agents approve the same final candidate before pushing or releasing; content changes invalidate approvals.

Every new release attaches a checksummed Markdown/JSON report with measured host pass rates, requirement coverage and gaps, unrun checks and version-specific changelog/release/workflow links. Invalid evidence blocks publication.
Main requires PRs, strict GitHub Actions host checks including two fresh agent approvals, administrator enforcement, resolved conversations and no force pushes/deletion.
requirements.gap: Live protection is verified through the GitHub API; there is no automated live rejected-push test. Agent identities remain workflow attestations, and administrators can change repository settings.

requirements.criterion: Named monitor profiles support shared phone/monitor create, rename, explicit update and delete with validated names and independent snapshots.
requirements.gap: Native phone create/rename/delete and monitor list/name input/apply passed on Black Shark 4; agent inspected captures and user approved both layouts. Full monitor CRUD interaction, large text/long lists and hardware-keyboard variants remain unverified.

requirements.criterion: Profile application previews dimensions/DPI/rotation and binds only on Keep; Revert/timeout/Stop/failure preserve the old association, with input and app overrides intact.
requirements.gap: Native preview/Keep/Revert/timeout/Stop/restart passed on Black Shark 4, including display cleanup. Resize-failure injection, physical disconnect during preview and third-party app continuity remain unverified.

requirements.criterion: Monitor bindings restore valid profiles automatically, fall back safely, migrate legacy settings once and allow forgetting without deleting named profiles. Separately confirmed working settings survive restart without mutating snapshots.
requirements.gap: Host identity/persistence tests and single-monitor native restart paths passed. JoyUI denies physical-ID access and uses disclosed capabilities fallback. Real two-monitor reconnects, cable/port changes and process death require verification.

requirements.criterion: Android 16/17 emulator launch, idle visibility, modern target/foreground lifecycle, system insets and Back behavior are verified while retaining Android 11 compatibility.
requirements.gap: Build-31 Black Shark Android 11 passes all ten connected suites in 20261015T172555.772434Z, including controller background/reopen, Settings/Close and fresh monitor touch at four rotations. Build-22 Samsung Android 16 eight-suite full pass and real Carousell handoff are historical. Android 17 latest historical child run still drops a rotation-2 input transition; earlier pass does not certify reliability. Final build 31 modern-OS rerun, other OEMs/removed-window recovery, installer warnings, physical-finger breadth, full performance protocol and remaining-app full-frame margins remain gaps. See testresults/0.11.1/android11-release-validation/README.md and task-handoff-and-resume/README.md.

requirements.criterion: Phone and monitor Settings show the installed version name, build number and debug identity immediately using shared read-only styling.
requirements.gap: Build-31 Android 11 full run 20261015T172555.772434Z passes phone/monitor installed-package version assertions. Agent inspected Settings/keyboard captures, including monitor Version 0.11.1 Build 31 Debug. Phone Settings initial-version pixels and human layout approval remain unverified; earlier Samsung captures have historical build identity.

requirements.criterion: Actual desktop task occupancy restores idle when the last app moves to the phone or exits; remaining apps, state and relaunch remain usable without task stealing.
requirements.gap: Build-31 Black Shark Android 11 full run 20261015T172555.772434Z passes four-rotation task handoff/idle pixels, Apps/Back input, state/relaunch, Fit preview, remaining-task visibility and explicit fixture finish. Build-22 Samsung full pass and real Carousell handoff are historical. Android 17 latest historical child run still has an intermittent input failure. Query-failure/stale-callback injection, root-Back background policy and broader OEM/app reuse remain unverified; remaining-app full-frame crop/size margins lack human visual approval. See testresults/0.11.1/android11-release-validation/README.md.

requirements.criterion: Both Apps menus acknowledge promptly, load asynchronously with shared cache and visible pending/error state, and remain dismissible without stale callbacks.
requirements.gap: Build-31 Android 11 full run 20261015T172555.772434Z passes pending/cache/search, refresh, retry, four-rotation warm opens and late dismissal. Accepted-action-to-first-OnDraw: cold phone/monitor 61/101 ms (n=1 each), warm phone n=10 p50/p95 63/78 ms, monitor n=12 47/62 ms. Samsung build-23 catalog evidence is historical. Human layout approval, input-to-photon/frame pacing, 100-sample protocol, alternate resolution/DPI, process teardown/package-broadcast/stale invalidation injection, final-build modern-OS reruns remain gaps. See testresults/0.11.1/android11-release-validation/README.md.

requirements.criterion: Protected window limitations and Chrome opt-in privacy configuration are explicit; no silent protection changes or unsupported secure-render claims.
requirements.gap: Samsung Chrome FLAG_SECURE and missing shell secure-capture permission verified. No Chrome flag changed; optional instructions and protected-window Help are documented separately under DX-PROTECTED-001. Samsung primary evidence distinguishes direct-monitor Secret mode from PC mirroring; Chrome-specific DeX behavior is not independently verified.

requirements.criterion: Visible protected windows on the current desktop trigger minimal Help notices and shared self-service instructions, with safe unknown state, OEM joined-header parsing, dismissal and session cleanup.
requirements.gap: Build-31 Black Shark Android 11 full ten-suite run 20261015T172555.772434Z passes, including protected same-window on/off, four rotations, native touch/pointer Help, outside dismissal/no click-through, repeated episodes, phone-only exclusion, Stop and controller recovery. Ten JVM parser tests include JoyUI joined-header clearing. Build-24 Samsung Android 16 evidence is historical. Agent inspected current phone/monitor guides; human visual approval, real Chrome mode, monitor Settings fallback interaction, Android 17 detection, Fit/DPI/font variants, occupied-session query-failure/stale-callback injection and query-load/frame latency remain gaps. See testresults/0.11.1/android11-release-validation/README.md.

requirements.criterion: Android 11 monitor contact owns arbitration while waiting for focus, cancels buffered events with shared input cancellation, and starts after focus settles without mid-contact focus loss or lost semantic tap.
requirements.gap: Build-31 Black Shark Android 11 full ten-suite run 20261015T172555.772434Z passes semantic reader taps with no focus loss in four rotations, background/reopen, direct touch, multi-touch, phone pointer and menus. New controlled component checks use real phone focus then same-turn monitor dispatch to verify ownership during wait, generic/navigation/touch-setting cancellation, no late replay, valid release exactly once and phone pointer recovery. Four native DOWN-to-reader-dispatch samples 24/22/22/21 ms: nearest-rank p50/p95 22/24 ms, excluding rendering; not the 100-sample performance protocol. Deterministic overflow/stale-host injection, physical-finger breadth, other legacy OEMs and full latency distributions remain gaps. See testresults/0.11.1/android11-release-validation/README.md.
